scenes.title: Every Drop Matters
scenes.narration: Did you know our freshwater is limited? That means every single drop really counts!
scenes.image_prompt: A giant translucent water droplet resting gently on the palm of a stylized hand against a bright clean backdrop.

scenes.title: Brush Without Waste
scenes.narration: First, always turn off the faucet while brushing your teeth instead of letting it run.
scenes.image_prompt: A bright toothbrush resting on a bathroom sink next to a closed shiny metal faucet.

scenes.title: Stop the Drips
scenes.narration: Second, help spot leaking taps and pipes. Even tiny drips waste huge amounts over time.
scenes.image_prompt: A single water droplet suspended under a pipe fixture above a small colorful puddle.

scenes.title: Quick Shower Power
scenes.narration: Third, take short, refreshing showers instead of filling up long baths.
scenes.image_prompt: A sleek modern showerhead spraying a brief mist next to a round clock timer.

scenes.title: Full Loads Only
scenes.narration: Fourth, remind your family to run the washing machine only when it is completely full.
scenes.image_prompt: A front-loading washing machine filled to capacity with colorful folded laundry.

scenes.title: Catch the Rain
scenes.narration: Fifth, collect rainwater outside in buckets and reuse it to give thirsty plants a drink.
scenes.image_prompt: A bright watering can catching clear raindrops beside a row of potted green plants.

scenes.title: Make a Difference
scenes.narration: Small habits practiced every day add up to make a giant difference for our planet!
scenes.image_prompt: A thriving green plant sprout emerging from dark soil beneath warm glowing sunbeams.

timeline.narration: Did you know our freshwater is limited? That means every single drop really counts!
First, always turn off the faucet while brushing your teeth instead of letting it run.
Second, help spot leaking taps and pipes. Even tiny drips waste huge amounts over time.
Third, take short, refreshing showers instead of filling up long baths.
Fourth, remind your family to run the washing machine only when it is completely full.
Fifth, collect rainwater outside in buckets and reuse it to give thirsty plants a drink.
Small habits practiced every day add up to make a giant difference for our planet!
